exposure: Modafinil and methylphenidate use during pregnancy
cohort: 25 patients with narcolepsy with cataplexy and 75 women in the control group
finding: Women with narcolepsy with cataplexy had similar pregnancy outcomes to controls, except for a higher prevalence of gestational diabetes and longer breastfeeding duration.
mod_finding: Induced deliveries were less frequent in women with narcolepsy with cataplexy compared to controls.
birth_weight: Neonates born to mothers with narcolepsy with cataplexy had heavier birth weight
